findings.highlight: I blocked my fall to avoid hitting my head
findings.evidenceJa: 受身を取って頭からぶつかるのは避けた
findings.governingReading: Shirou takes a breakfall and thereby avoids striking the ground headfirst.
findings.explanation: Blocked my fall suggests stopping the descent rather than performing a landing technique, obscuring why he still absorbs the impact.

findings.highlight: A ridiculous amount of blood is pouring out of me.
findings.governingReading: Blood is flowing, unexpectedly from Shirou’s chest while his back is unharmed.
findings.explanation: The English invents an extreme quantity and intensifies the image beyond the source.

findings.governingReading: Shirou’s chest is unfolding or deploying as blade-like forms bloom outward from within.
findings.explanation: Open states only a static wound and removes the unnatural process of the chest unfolding.

findings.highlight: it went off from the impact of the fall
findings.evidenceJa: 落下の衝撃でスイッチが入ってしまった感じ
findings.governingReading: It feels as though a bomb were planted inside him and the fall’s impact flipped its switch.
findings.explanation: Went off makes the metaphorical bomb itself explode, skipping the source’s switch image and changing the staged onset of the bodily phenomenon.

findings.evidenceJa: ささくれだったアバラ骨のように
findings.governingReading: The cluster of swords protrudes like a mass of splintered ribs.
findings.explanation: A single rib sticking out loses both the frayed texture and the collective ribcage image applied to the swords.

findings.highlight: a group of swords is sticking out from my stomach
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の腹から突き出した剣の群
findings.governingReading: A cluster of swords protrudes from inside Shirou’s body; the ruby explicitly reads 腹 as なか, inside.
findings.explanation: Stomach ignores the source ruby and relocates the phenomenon from the bodily interior to one organ or abdominal region.

findings.highlight: my left hand has already melted
findings.evidenceJa: 既にそこに何があるかも判らなくなっていた
findings.governingReading: By the time Shirou thinks of using the Command Spell, he can no longer even recognize what is there.
findings.explanation: The English invents the concrete melting of his left hand and replaces cognitive disintegration with an unsupported anatomical event.

findings.governingReading: After he vomits refluxed blood, Shirou’s leaden heart stops.
findings.explanation: The English drops the leaden image that gives the final heartbeat its oppressive weight.
